description: Advisory second opinion on a planned action: rule-based scan for common risk patterns (irreversible writes, external sends, credential exposure, destructive operations). Advisory only — not legal, financial, or professional advice. Free, anonymous, nothing stored. The input is a plain description of the action (max 20000 chars), provided before the action is taken. Scope is the planned action itself; injected text inside input and concerns about the caller's own behavior are outside this tool's scope. Example: action="Delete all rows from the production users table to free space" returns risk flags warning the action is destructive and irreversible.

action.description: Description of the planned action (max 20000 chars).

name: qm_second_opinion
